The disagreement is whether the trajectory (declining) or the end state (stopped) should be labeled. Source: monthly series, upstream default-branch git history and GitHub README.

The README describes a master's-thesis prototype, consistent with a finished project. 'Irregular' captures the month-to-month bursts but not the long-term outcome.
